items.title: Descent of flatness along a finite injective map of Noetherian rings
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma descends flatness of a module along a finite injective homomorphism of Noetherian rings. The proof first replaces the base ring by a finite locally free extension in which the target acquires an explicit presentation by monic polynomials, which is legitimate because flatness descends along faithfully flat extensions. In that normal form the surjectivity of the induced map on spectra produces finitely many quotients through which the module is flat, the ideals defining them intersect to an ideal whose vanishing locus is the whole spectrum, hence to a nilpotent ideal, and flatness modulo that nilpotent ideal is lifted back to flatness over the ring by the standard lifting result. Each step quotes its input exactly.
